description: Research source-bound EU role requirements with exact passages, act-specific definitions, conditions, unknown facts and EN/FR/DE/IT official source availability. Select multiple roles and an optional activity, product, Spain or France, and date. Country links carry their relationship type and review state. Informative national text appears only as a separate research lead, not verified country coverage. An absent link is a coverage gap, never proof that national law is absent. This is a bounded research aid, not a compliance verdict. Uses the ordinary signed-in Nexus allowance.

activity.description: Activity from the response catalogue, e.g. selling-online.

asAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD; only source-supported dates are shown.

country.description: ES or FR for national connections.

product.description: Product from the response catalogue, e.g. consumer-goods.

roles.description: Comma-separated scoped role keys, e.g. crd:trader,gpsr:manufacturer. Omit to see all current candidates.

name: explore_role_requirements

outputSchema.description: The JSON response from the corresponding Lexiara API route.
